name: onesie
description: Skills that teach Codex to drive the onesie CLI: single judgments, CI gates, calibrated cuts, questions chained into patterns and streamed batches.

interface.shortDescription: Correct onesie invocations for judgments, gates, calibration and batches
interface.longDescription: Teach Codex to drive the onesie CLI: ask for a probability, a pick or a rating on one piece of text, gate a CI step on a judgment, calibrate the cut a gate uses against labelled records, chain questions when one cannot answer, and stream a file of records through onesie.
defaultPrompt: Use onesie to judge this text.
Gate this CI step on a onesie judgment.
Calibrate this gate against our labelled records.
Run this file of records through onesie.
